blocks.text: One day is set aside for a boat dive off Fernando de Noronha. The water temperature stays around 27 °C and visibility is high. Underwater, you can encounter shoals of fish, rays and turtles, rocky areas and a sandy seabed. Certified divers dive in small groups, while beginners receive a briefing and have an instructor of their own.

blocks.text:
Flight to Recife. On arrival, you will be met and transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax.

Recife is the capital of Pernambuco and a major seaport in northeastern Brazil. It stands at the mouth of the Capibaribe River, where the river divides into branches before reaching the Atlantic Ocean. Its canals, bridges and boats by the quays have earned it the nickname "Brazilian Venice".

The city retains traces of Portuguese and Dutch rule: churches, mansions and historic buildings with carved balconies and facades darkened by time. Recife also has a lively modern side, with many cafés, restaurants, shops and places for an evening stroll, while the ocean is always close by.

The first day is deliberately relaxed. After your flight, you can rest at the hotel, walk along the waterfront or simply get used to the climate of northeastern Brazil before the full day of sightseeing that follows.
